notes: Box model fitted on 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 explains 31% of offensive and 13% of defensive no-prior ratings this season before the team adjustment (2847 players with >= 500 possessions). The adjustment is solved to match team ratings, so it is not scored here.

Pythagorean exponent fitted on raw efficiencies: 7.79. Pomeroy's ratings page reports 10.25-11.5 for schedule-adjusted efficiencies; raw efficiencies give lower exponents because strong teams face strong schedules.
